subject: Runway assertion: HorizonAI capacity readiness check and provisional reservation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Runway assertion: HorizonAI capacity check

Tessa / Monica —

HorizonAI is in final commercial review this week and asked for a committed runway for their planned production cutoff (model: horizon-70b / expected seq len: 4k). They want reassurance we can scale to sustained inference throughput for their projected Q4 launch. High level: 10k concurrent users with peaks that could drive ~120k tokens/s.

We discussed a potential Dedicated contract (12+ month) but the legal/finance timeline is slipping; procurement asked if we can provision a provisional reservation while they finalize PO. They specifically requested: what size and duration we could earmark without breaking other commitments.

Can you run a quick availability snapshot and suggested provisional reservation? Attached: runway_estimate_horizonai_Q4.xlsx (numbers they shared).

Key asks:
- What GPU mix would you recommend for a 90-day provisional hold that keeps latency SLOs under 250ms p95?
- Which existing late-stage deals would this impact and by how much?
- Ops lead time and whether a soft hold vs hard reservation is appropriate.

Thanks — I realize this is short notice.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway assertion: HorizonAI capacity check

Aditya / Tessa —

I pulled the fleet snapshot and ran a quick allocation model against the horizon-70b profile and anticipated SeqLen distribution. Summary below (see attached fleet_snapshot_20261029.csv for node-level details):

Current free capacity (US region, uncommitted):
- H100 80GB equivalent slots: 18
- A100 80GB equivalent slots: 44
- T4 / inference-class: not suitable for their latency target

Suggested provisional reservation (to meet p95 <250ms on their traffic curve):
- Preferred: 16 x H100 (for stable KV cache and lower latency) + 28 x A100 (burst and background jobs) — this provides a conservative runway for 90 days and allows rolling upgrades.
- Minimum viable soft-hold: 10 x H100 + 16 x A100 (trailable, but risk of p95 spikes during peak).

Impacts / tradeoffs:
- If we earmark 16 H100 today, that consumes the majority of H100 pool and may affect two mid-stage deals (HS-48812, HS-48990). I recommend we offer HorizonAI a 60-day provisional hard reservation while they expedite PO, convertible to a 12+ month commitment once signed.

Ops / lead-time notes:
- We can place an internal provisional hold ticket and mark nodes as "reserved-provisional" within 24 hours. Hard reservation that removes nodes from autoscale would require leadership sign-off (to avoid SLA/regret on other customers).
- Quantization routing and prefix caching could reduce H100 demand by ~25% if they accept a slight model quality tradeoff.

Next step: if you want me to open the provisional hold ticket, confirm size (preferred/minimum) and hold window.

— Monica
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway assertion: HorizonAI capacity check

All —

I agree with Monica's assessment but would tighten the recommendation to balance risk across active pipeline. Proposal: provisional reservation = 12 x H100 + 24 x A100 for an initial 60-day window, with the following controls:

- Escalation gating: If HorizonAI signs SOW within 30 days, convert to firm reserve; otherwise, automatically release 50% of the provisional hold at day 45.
- Ticket: PRV-4873 (provisional-hold) will track the allocation and owner. Ops can label hardware as "soft-reserved" (no impact to autoscaling) or "hard-reserved" (removed from pool).
- Pricing: offer a 25% uplift on standard dedicated rate for provisional reservations that materially reduce available H100 capacity. That keeps economics aligned with risk.

Operational considerations: preemptible GPU options aren't acceptable for HorizonAI's p95 SLA; avoid mixing preemptible capacity into the hold. If we must, only allow <=20% of total hold as preemptible and require explicit acceptance.

If Tessa + Sales approve, I'll kick off PRV-4873 and coordinate with Ops to mark nodes.

— Rishi
VP, Product Operations (Capacity)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@horizonai.com>, Sofia Marin <sofia@horizonai.com>, procurement@horizonai.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway assertion: HorizonAI capacity check

Liam / Sofia / Horizon procurement —

Thanks for the transparency over the last week. Internal capacity review is complete. To remove blockers from your launch timeline while legal finalizes the SOW, Redwood can place a provisional reservation as follows: 12 x H100 (80GB equiv) + 20 x A100 (80GB equiv) for 60 days, effective immediately.

What this means:
- We will mark the above capacity as "provisional hold PRV-4873" in our scheduling system; nodes will remain available for your workloads and will be protected from other dedicated reservations.
- Hold is contingent on receipt of a signed non-binding LOI or a purchase order within 30 days. If neither is received, the hold will be reduced per the gating rules Rishi noted.
- Pricing: we will issue a provisional reservation uplift invoice (25% uplift on committed rate) to hold the capacity; invoice will be credited toward the final committed contract if signed.

Attachments: provisional_hold_form.pdf (simple acceptance + billing details), runway_estimate_horizonai_Q4.xlsx, fleet_snapshot_20261029.csv

Next steps for HorizonAI: please sign and return the provisional_hold_form.pdf and confirm billing details. Procurement: if you can route a PO referencing PRV-4873 that will secure the reservation while SOW circulates.

Aditya / Monica / Rishi — please open PRV-4873 and coordinate node tagging and billing. Ops: tag as soft-reserved unless we receive a PO that requires hard-reserve.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
